turns.message: My darlings!! Happy New Year to everyone in this family. God has brought us to another year , I am grateful. How is everyone? I have not heard from some of you in days. Please reply so I know you are fine
Happy New Year Mum. Dad. Everyone. Sophia and the boys send their love. Hope Lagos is peaceful
Happy new year family!! 🎉🎉 we made it!! David and the kids say happy new year. Nkechi and Ife are already arguing about who gets the TV lol
Happy new year everyone!! 🥂 honestly though I cannot believe it's 2025 already
My children, happy new year. God willing this year brings health and prosperity to this family. Your father, Emeka
My people, happy new year!! Ehen! God has been faithful. I am so happy to see everyone well. Let us make this year a wonderful one for this family
Ehhh happy new year Okafor family!! 🎊🎊 This is OUR year. I already have big plans. Watch this space
happy new year everyone 🙏 sorry I missed the midnight messages, I was in the library
Happy new year!! 🎉 Kunle did you see the family messages from last night?? 😂 aww this family
HAPPY NEW YEAR 🎉🎊✨
HAPY NEW YEAR EVRYONE!! 🎊🎊🎊 hi everybody
Happy New Year from us , Mummy G how are you doing? Hope you and Daddy Emeka are keeping well 💛
Sophia my dear thank you. We are well , God willing. Chidi I am glad you are fine. Kunle , how is your research? I have not heard a proper update in weeks. Please reply so I know you are fine
God bless this family. A new year , a new season of blessings. I will endeavour to visit more this year. In His name
Happy new year everyone 😊 just to say , excited for whatever 2025 brings for this family
Can I just say something? 💬 We have Mum and Dad's 35th anniversary this year. We NEED to do something special. I've been thinking about this
Ehen!! Adaeze is right! This is an important occasion. My people , we must plan something worthy of this family. I am already thinking
yes!! honestly though I think a smaller trip , just the immediate family , would be really special. No pressure but I think intimate is better 💛
Ehhh no no , we should invite the WHOLE family. I will sort it out , a big celebration at a venue. Leave it to me!! 🎊
Let me just check with everyone first. Okay so the first question is: small intimate trip or big family event? Let's hear everyone before we decide
Can I just say something? 🙋 I think the anniversary trip should be a city break. Paris or Lisbon. Mum and Dad would love it and it's manageable for everyone
My people , I like the sound of Paris. That would be a proper occasion. Ehen! Something to remember
honestly though I think Scotland could be beautiful. Quieter , more relaxing , easier for everyone to travel within the UK. Just a thought 💛
tbf Scotland makes sense logistically. I'm in for either
Ehhh I say we go big. Paris is the one!! I will sort out the flights. Leave it to me , I know people 🎊
leaving it to the family on this one. Adaeze what do you think?
I mean , Paris. As I said before. But I can see Scotland working if people find flights difficult
just to confirm , what are we thinking for dates? Mummy G , would May work for you?
May works , God willing. But I want to know the plans properly in advance , not last minute. Please do not surprise me with anything. I need to prepare 💛
Mummy G would want to know everything in advance so she can prepare properly , that is just how she feels comfortable. So let's agree a timeline early
My children, as long as Grace is happy, I am happy. We do not need a big occasion. Just the children and grandchildren would be enough for me. Your father, Emeka
Ehen! Emeka , you always say that but then you enjoy it when it happens. We are planning a proper occasion
God bless this family. I will endeavour to join for the main celebration. Dates would be helpful in advance. In His name
noted on the date request. just to say , I think whatever we decide , keeping it manageable is important. No pressure but we don't want it to become stressful
wait actually can I vote?? I think Scotland would be so pretty 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
I WANT TO GO SOMWHERE WITH CASTLES!! can we go to Scotland?? 🏰🏰
Okay so the plan so far: Scotland is leading. Adaeze you're okay with that? Let me just check with everyone first before we book
fine , I still think Paris would have been more special. But okay. Scotland. As I said though , I think a city break would have been nicer 🙄
Ehhh let's vote: Paris versus Scotland. I say Paris!! Who else says Paris?? 🇫🇷
Okay so the plan is , Scotland it is. Final. I'll start looking at dates. @Adaeze @Tolu please send me your available weekends in May
Right. Scotland , Edinburgh area , May 16-18. Accommodation options sent to the group. Can everyone confirm attendance by end of this week
confirmed!! David and I are in. Kids too obviously 🎉
in!! ✅ honestly though can we maybe have one evening that's just the siblings and kids? Not the whole extended group? Just an idea 💛
on it. I'll confirm dates this week
Kunle did you see this?? 😂 please actually confirm this time. I'm in btw!! aww this is going to be so good
just to confirm , Chidi and I are in. Mummy G , we can arrange the travel from your end if you let us know what you need
Thank you Sophia. God willing we will all be there. I just want to know the full programme in advance , not surprises please. What is the plan each day?
My people , I am in. Ehen! This is going to be a wonderful occasion. Emeka , you and Grace deserve this
Can I just say something? 💡 what if we hired a private chef for the Saturday dinner? It would make the evening feel really special
Ehhh YES!! Great idea. I will sort out the chef , I know someone in Edinburgh. Leave it to me!! 🍽️
@Uncle Femi appreciate the offer. Let me just check with everyone first on budget before we commit. @Adaeze good idea though
leaving it to the family on this one. makes sense though
noted. just to say , a private chef sounds lovely but a simpler dinner can be just as special. No pressure but worth considering both options
God bless this family. I will endeavour to be there for the Saturday. In His name
Sophia , has Kunle paid his deposit share yet? Just checking before I send the full amount
not to overstep but , I checked and Kunle's share hasn't come through yet. @Kunle are you sorting this week?
sorry I missed this. on it!! I'll transfer today. tbf I've had a crazy week with my viva prep
Kunle!! as I said before , we needed deposits in by last week. Please just do it now 😅
My children, let us not lose the forest for the trees. The important thing is we are all together. The rest will work out. Your father, Emeka
Emeka is right. But Kunle please sort the payment today. I have been watching this chat and worrying. Please reply so I know you have done it
How is everyone? I have not heard from Tolu in a few days. Tolu are you okay? Please reply so I know you are fine
Mum I'm fine!! actually , everyone , I have news. I got promoted!! head of brand at the agency. Honestly I wasn't going to say anything yet but here we are 🎉
TOLU!! I knew you would!! I'm so proud of you!! 🥹🥹 this is amazing!! she said she was going to tell you all this week , I am so happy for her
Adaeze!! I told you not to give it away!! 😂 yes I told her first , she's my sister, sorry everyone
My darling Tolu!! God has been good! I am so proud of you. Adaeze , you knew? How long have you known? 😂
Tolu! That's brilliant. Well done. Okay so the plan is , we celebrate properly in Scotland 🥂
Ehen!! Tolu my daughter!! This is wonderful news. God is faithful. Ehen!!
Ehhh Tolu!! Building on success!! That is what I like to see. This family is unstoppable!! 🎊🎊 speaking of which , I will definitely sort the chef for Scotland. Already on it
aww Tolu!!! that's so amazing!! 🎉 Kunle did you see this??
yes!! congrats Tolu!! tbf I saw Adaeze's reaction before I read the message and guessed something good had happened
omg Aunty Tolu congrats!! 🎉🎊✨
CONGRADS AUNTY TOLU!! 🎉🎉
Tolu!! So happy for you. Mummy G , I was bursting to say something when you mentioned Tolu earlier , she told Adaeze first so we all knew it was coming 😊
congrats Tolu. well deserved
aww congrats Tolu!! 🎉 just to say , you absolutely deserve this
thank you all!! honestly though this family 😭 also , any update on Scotland logistics?
Scotland update: venue confirmed , deposit paid by all (thanks Kunle). Programme: Friday arrival, Saturday walking + dinner, Sunday brunch and depart. @Adaeze you happy with the plan?
yes fine. I still think a city break would have been more special but as I said before , Scotland it is. Excited 😊
God bless this family. Wonderful news Tolu. I will endeavour to arrive Saturday morning. In His name
My children, I am proud of you all. Tolu, this is wonderful news. God willing we celebrate together in May. Your father, Emeka
Right, Scotland activities. Options: Arthur's Seat hike , Holyrood Park walk , whisky distillery tour , Pentland Hills trail. What does everyone want?
the distillery tour sounds amazing!! and Holyrood is manageable for everyone. Can I just say something , the Pentland Hills trail might be a lot for the older members 🥾
Ehhh I say we do Arthur's Seat!! That is a proper experience!! I will lead the way!! 🏔️
My people , let me say something. We should not plan anything too strenuous. Emeka should take it easy , the doctors have said to watch his pressure. Holyrood park walk is better
Ngozi what do you mean , watch his pressure?? Emeka , are you okay?? I have not heard anything about this. Please explain. I am very worried
My children, please do not worry. It is nothing serious. Ngozi should not have mentioned it here. I am fine. Your father, Emeka
Grace , I only found out last week when Emeka called me. He did not want to worry you. It is a precaution only
Dad , I'll call you this week. @Sophia can you check the cottage stairs situation. Okay so the plan is , we keep activities gentle. Distillery tour and Holyrood walk , no strenuous hiking
just to confirm , the cottage is single storey, no steep stairs. And I'll check the walk distances. Mummy G , don't worry , we'll make sure Daddy is comfortable
Thank you Sophia. God willing he is fine. Emeka , you must tell me these things. I am your wife. Please reply so I know everything is okay
honestly though Dad you scared us a bit. But glad Aunty Ngozi flagged it. Holyrood walk sounds perfect 💛
agreed. gentle activities it is. Also can we do a family photos session? Can I just say something , we haven't had proper family photos in years 📸
tbf I think gentle activities are better anyway. I'm not really a hiker. On it for the distillery though 🥃
omg family photos yes!! aww this is going to be so good 📸
omg wait actually can I take the photos?? I've been doing photography at school 📷
I WANT TO DO THE HIKE!! can we do the hike??
God bless this family. Emeka , your health is in God's hands. Gentle activities are wise. I will endeavour to join the walk. In His name
leaving it to the family on this one. gentle walk sounds good to me
noted on the activities. just to say , the distillery and Holyrood walk is a lovely combination , no pressure but we should keep the programme light. Simple often works best
Ehhh okay okay , gentle it is. I will organise a private minibus for the group transport!! Leave it to me!! 🚌
Budget update. Cottage: sorted. Private chef Adaeze suggested: quotes coming in at £800-1000. Group minibus Uncle Femi offered: still waiting on confirmation
ehhh yes , minibus. I'm looking into it. Might take a few more days
Uncle Femi , you said you'd sort it last week. Can I just say something , we need a confirmed plan. Should we just book it ourselves?
I'll come back to you on this. Let me see what I can do
just to confirm , if Uncle Femi can't sort the minibus by this weekend, Chidi and I can book a minivan hire. Happy to do that
On it. @Uncle Femi just need a yes or no by Friday please. Otherwise Sophia will book the van
My people , let me say something. The private chef is a wonderful idea. Ehen! We should also arrange a proper thanksgiving service. I will speak to Pastor Emeka
God bless this family. I will endeavour to lead a short thanksgiving on Sunday morning. In His name
A thanksgiving , how wonderful. God willing we will all be there. I want the full programme written down , day by day. I do not like surprises with these things 💛
noted. just to say , a short thanksgiving sounds really nice. Simple and meaningful
honestly though I hope we have some unstructured time too? Not every minute planned? 💛 just for people to relax and catch up properly
agree with Tolu on that. some breathing room would be good
David!! leaving it to the family I thought 😂 but yes fine , some free time. As I said , just as long as we have the main things confirmed
Kunle did you see the minibus situation?? 😂 aww this family
sorry I missed this. yes I saw. on it for my share of the chef cost. tbf the chef idea is amazing
omg wait actually can I have my own table?? 😂 the cousins table
CAN THE COUSINS TABLE HAVE EXTRA DESSERT??
My children, I see the plans are coming together. We do not need a big occasion. Just having everyone together is enough for me. Your father, Emeka
Dad!! we WANT to celebrate you properly. You deserve it 🥹
Okay so the plan is: Uncle Femi confirms minibus by Friday or we book van. Chef quote approved if under £900. Thanksgiving Sunday. Free afternoon Saturday. Any objections?
just to confirm , minibus is booked by us. Uncle Femi , no worries. Chef confirmed at £850 , everyone please pay your share by next week
sorry for the delay. good that Sophia sorted it. I'll transfer my share
Can I just say something? This is exactly why we need a plan. As I said before , people need to commit. Thank you Sophia 🙏
Sorted. @Adaeze noted. @Kunle please confirm chef payment this week
on it
Kunle!! I am watching you 👀 aww but really this trip is going to be so good
honestly though really excited now 💛 can we also discuss room arrangements? I was thinking maybe Adaeze and I share , and then siblings together?
yes!! sibling sleepover vibes!! 🥹 David you don't mind right?
of course not. leaving it to the family on this one. if everyone agrees it probably won't happen anyway 😄
David!! 😂
How is everyone? I have not heard a proper update from Chidi in days. Chidi , are you okay? Please reply so I know you are fine
Fine Mum. Busy. On it for Scotland. Let me just check the room list and I'll send
Mummy G , Chidi is fine , it's been a busy week at the surgery. not to overstep but , he'll be himself by Scotland
My people , the thanksgiving programme. I spoke to Pastor Emeka. Ehen! He will speak for 20 minutes Sunday morning. This is good
God bless this family. Confirmed for Sunday. Short but meaningful. I will endeavour to arrive Saturday evening. In His name
noted on Pastor Emeka. just to say , 20 minutes is a good length. Not too long
wait actually who is in the cousins room?? 😂
ME!! I WANT TO BE IN THE COUSINS ROOM
aww the cousins room!! Kunle are you coming into the cousins room?? 😂
tbf yes. I'm basically a cousin anyway
Final headcount. 13 confirmed, 2 TBC (Uncle Femi, Pastor Emeka). @Aunty Ngozi @Amara please confirm
Confirmed!! Ehen! I cannot wait. My people , this is going to be a wonderful occasion
confirmed!! 🎉 Kunle did you confirm?? aww I am so excited
sorry I missed this. yes confirmed!! on it for the final payment
Can I just say something about the Saturday dinner? Since we have a private chef , I think we should dress up properly. Make it an occasion
leaving it to the family on this one. though personally I'd be just as happy in something casual. formal dinners are a lot
honestly though I think smart casual is a good middle ground? Not everyone loves a full formal dinner 💛
noted. smart casual sounds right to me. just to say , the meal will be special regardless of what we wear
okay , smart casual then. As I said before , I just wanted it to feel special. Fine 😊
Mummy G , just to confirm , the schedule: Friday 3pm arrive, settle in. Saturday: 10am Holyrood walk , 1pm lunch, free time, 7pm private dinner. Sunday: 10am thanksgiving , noon brunch , depart
Sophia thank you. This is exactly what I needed. God willing everything will be beautiful. I am so happy to have it all written down 💛
My children, I am looking forward to this. Just the family together is all I want. Your father, Emeka
confirmed!! I will be there. No more delays from me 🎊
Ehen! Uncle Femi showing up properly. My people , we are going to celebrate in style
God bless this family. I will endeavour to arrive Saturday evening as planned. In His name
omg I'm packing already!! 🎒✨
CAN I BRING MY SWITCH??
Ife you can bring your Switch but put it away during dinner 😂💛
Sorted. See everyone in Edinburgh 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
see everyone there!! tbf I'm actually looking forward to this
9 days!! Who is getting there when? 🎉 Can I just say something , I'm SO excited now
meee!! Friday afternoon. honestly though this is going to be the best 💛
Mummy G , just to confirm , we have arranged a car from the airport for you and Daddy
Thank you Sophia my dear. God willing we will all arrive safely. I am so happy we have a plan. I cannot wait to see everyone 💛
My people , I am already packed. Ehen! 9 days!! This is going to be a wonderful occasion for this family
aww 9 days!! Kunle did you see this?? are you packed?? 😂
I will start packing this weekend. on it. tbf I just need to not forget my train ticket
omg Kunle 😂 wait actually should I bring a nice dress for the dinner?
Nkechi YES!! Smart casual but cute!! 🥰
noted on the dinner. sounds nice
leaving it to the family on this one. see everyone there
ehhh 9 days!! I am ready. I will bring a surprise for Emeka and Grace on the night!! 🎊
Femi , what surprise?? I do not want surprises , please tell me what you are planning. I need to know in advance. Please reply so I know
Femi!! My people , you know Grace does not like surprises. Tell us what it is so we can coordinate
okay okay , it is a small video montage of family photos I put together. Nothing dramatic 😄
Oh Femi , that is so lovely. Thank you. I am relieved it is not a big surprise. God willing it will be beautiful 💛
Good. Sorted
God bless this family. On my way to Edinburgh Saturday. I will endeavour to be on time. In His name
My children, I am ready. Just having everyone in the same room is the gift. Your father, Emeka
this family 😭💛 see everyone very soon
My darlings!! That was one of the best weekends of my life. God is faithful!! I am still crying happy tears. How is everyone? I hope you all got home safely. Please reply so I know you are fine 💛
Mum 😭😭 it was PERFECT!! Can I just say something , Scotland was the right choice. As I said before I wanted Paris but Scotland was absolutely beautiful 😂🥹
honestly though that dinner was so good 😭 and the small cousins-and-siblings breakfast on Sunday? That was my favourite moment. Everything felt right 💛
Ehen!! I said it would be a wonderful occasion and it was!! My people , this family. The thanksgiving was beautiful. Pastor Emeka , you spoke so well
God bless this family. What a privilege to celebrate with you. God has truly blessed the Okafor name. In His name
Great weekend. Glad it all came together. Let me just check if there are any outstanding payments and I'll send a summary
Mummy G so happy to see you so happy 💛 Daddy Emeka , I hope the walk wasn't too much?
My children, I am so proud of this family. The walk was perfect. I did not need anything more than this. Your father, Emeka
that was incredible. sorry I missed the first part of the walk. on it for any outstanding payment. tbf that thanksgiving actually moved me
ehhh what a weekend!! The video montage went down well I think 😄 more of this family
aww I cried at the video!! Kunle you were literally crying 😂
tbf I was not crying I had something in my eye
omg my photos came out SO GOOD!! wait actually can I share them here??
THE COUSINS TABLE WAS THE BEST TABLE 🏆🏆
good weekend. really good. well organised Chidi, Sophia, everyone
just to say , the dinner was lovely. And the walk was exactly the right pace. Really glad it was kept simple
Nkechi yes share them!! 📸 and yes David I agree , really well done to everyone who organised. Can I just say something , Sophia and Chidi carried this
just to confirm , everyone home safe. Mummy G hope you and Daddy are resting. In His name  ,  that's for Pastor Emeka but honestly it applies 😊
this family honestly 😭💛 same time next year? honestly though maybe a slightly smaller group next time 😂
Same time next year , God willing!! How is everyone? I already miss you all. This has been the best gift. 💛💛
